newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Colombo port handles record cargo to May - paper.
newsitem.headline: Colombo port handles record cargo to May - paper.

text.p: Sri Lanka's main Colombo port handled record container cargo in the first five months of this year, the state-owned Daily News reported on Wednesday, quoting the Shipping Ministry.
It said the port handled 660,927 twenty-foot equivalent units (TEUs) in the January-May period this year compared to 979,882 TEUs in the whole of 1996.
It did not give comparative figures for the January-May period last year.
The newspaper said the port expected to handle 1.5 million TEUs this year.

Colombo is a major transshipment port for south Asia. Transshipment occurs when a vessel discharges cargo at an intermediate port and the goods are loaded on another ship bound for the final destination.
The Central Bank said in May that Colombo port's revenue rose 80 percent to 8.3 billion rupees ($143 million) in 1996 from 4.6 billion in the previous year.
